name: MakerThrive

sources.title: Batch-provided submit URL — returns 'this page took a wrong turn' (dead route)
Homepage — now a paid 'distribution engine for SaaS tools': YouTube features, newsletter, social amplification; CTA is 'Book a Partnership'

requirements: No free submission route — /submit is dead and the site only offers paid partnerships ('Book a Partnership', 'Partner with us', media kit)
Product should be a SaaS/AI/dev tool targeting marketers, founders, teams, or developers
Deliverable is a produced video breakdown + newsletter + social distribution, not a directory listing
preparation: Budget for a sponsored content partnership
Product narrative/angle — they 'align on a tactical narrative' rather than reading your landing page
Media kit review at /media-kit before booking
workflow: Review https://makerthrive.com/media-kit for formats and audience stats (10K+ YouTube subs, 13K+ newsletter, 56K+ X)
Book via /partner ('Book a spot' / 'Start a Partnership')
Align on angle; they produce a dedicated breakdown video and distribute across YouTube, X, newsletter
watchFor: Source-claimed /submit directory route no longer exists — this is a sponsorship channel, not a directory
Banner says 'MakerThrive's Community is evolving' — site is mid-pivot; older directory-style listings may be gone
No pricing published on the homepage — cost is revealed via the partnership flow
countsAsLive: A dedicated MakerThrive video/feature about the product is published on their YouTube channel and referenced from makerthrive.com
unknowns: Whether any free community listing still exists post-pivot
Whether a link on makerthrive.com itself (vs. just YouTube description) is included
